# v3.4.0 release preparation validation

Prepared locally on 2026-09-29. No commit, push, tag, GitHub release, npm publication, or deployment was performed.

## Current release target

The root, icons, and docs manifests now target 3.4.0, a minor release after the published 3.3.7 release. Release notes and upgrade documentation use the v3 line.

The [live-site audit](../reports/icon-exclusions-live-2026-09-29.md) supersedes the exclusion conclusions below: the 2,042 proposed removals include working icons. The exclusion scope and final catalog counts still need correction and validation before publication.

### Version-change checks

- Manifest assertions passed: all three versions are 3.4.0 and the TypeScript pin remains `~6.0.3`.
- Release-note assertions passed: title, installation command, and comparison link use 3.4.0.
- Focused `pnpm exec oxfmt --check` passed for all nine changed manifest and documentation files.
- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` passed without changing the lockfile.
- `pnpm --dir docs check:qpress` passed for all 17 Markdown routes.
- `git diff --check` passed. Icon generation and package builds were not rerun for this version-only change.

## Historical candidate validation

The remaining results describe the earlier, superseded 4.0.0 candidate. Its package paths, version, and checksums are retained as historical evidence; they do not validate a 3.4.0 release artifact.

### Earlier candidate result

- Removed the override SVGs and gradient/tracing approximations. Unsupported sources are excluded and documented in generated per-set READMEs.
- 125,056 exports in 94 sets: 134 additions and 2,042 removals relative to v3.3.7. The README index links to 2,085 exclusions in 24 sets, including 43 previously skipped sources. Existing family-wide omissions remain described in Known Issues.
- The earlier candidate used version 4.0.0 in all three workspace manifests and retained TypeScript `~6.0.3`. pnpm was 12.6.0; documentation used Quasar 2.34.0, App Vite 3.10.1, and Vue 3.5.43.
- Full Chromium 153 and Firefox 155 QIcon audits cover 161,431 exports across 108 sets, including Icon Explorer's 14 Quasar Extras sets. Both report zero blank renders, unresolved SVG references, invalid paths, invalid paint styles, metadata mismatches, or page errors.
- Chromium used Icon Explorer's Quasar 2.32.3; Firefox used Quasar 2.33.2 before the final docs dependency refresh. Quasar 2.34.0 has an identical `QIcon.js` SHA-256 to 2.33.2; the final docs browser smoke check also exercises its QIcon preview.
- All exported names match both declarations and JSON lists. Documented exclusions are absent from those exports.
- The final package contains 380 files, including the per-set READMEs, and excludes builder, test, and dependency directories. Packaged catalogs and README files match the working tree. pnpm intentionally strips the `prepack` script from the packaged manifest.

## Submodules

The earlier same-day audit checked all 21 top-level submodules plus nested Phosphor core using `git ls-remote --symref origin HEAD`, branch-specific `git fetch --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules`, and `git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...origin/<branch>`. All 21 top-level modules are current. All 22 checkouts are clean and match their parent-recorded commits; `git submodule status --recursive` was checked again after the exclusion changes.

Nested `packages/phosphor-icons/core` is five commits behind its own upstream, but its parent still records `33fb01d1`. The difference contains README updates and two search-tag corrections, with no SVG asset changes. Its parent-recorded pin remains intact. Raw audit: `/tmp/svg-submodule-audit-2026-09-29/results.json`.

## Limits and migration

Excluded exports are a breaking change: consuming applications must remove those imports, choose supported icons, or load original upstream SVGs using QIcon's `img:` support. Active upstream sources are retried on every build; historical snapshots use explicit exclusions.

The six full-canvas results are intentional square/stop icons. Bounding-box review candidates remain distinct from conversion defects (430 in Chromium; 427 in Firefox); a bounds-only finding is not proof of incorrect rendering. The earlier Font Awesome source comparison found the flagged geometry already present upstream. No Quasar Extras or Quasar core source was changed.

This historical candidate superseded an earlier override-based candidate. The subsequent live-site audit found that both `cifVa` exports already displayed correctly, so the blanket exclusion conclusions above do not establish release readiness.
